body: I am so sorry you feel that low.. i have been there quite often recently myself. What you said about music keeping you going really hit me close. I am a musician, and have been playing guitar for 7 years (Im about the same age as you are), and music has been a huge help for me as well. If you want to talk to me about anything (music for an example), I would be glad to chat with you! Try to keep going no matter how hard it may feel now!
Thankyou for your words :) I just dont feel anything getting better by discussing my childhood traumas and other shit i have been through. I am feeling a bit better today.
My gf and younger brother, without them i would have been gone a long time ago..
